staging.candidate_assets: relative symlink to the unchanged formal assets directory

changes: Hoisted the two immutable magnetic poles instead of allocating their array during every field sample.
Removed unused north, south, path-index and trajectory-tone state while retaining baseline token refresh timing: static colors on rebuild and the live trajectory color on every render.
Centralized animation cancellation in stopMotion so pause, reset, preference changes and teardown share one lifecycle path.
Removed host-only indentation while retaining conventional zero/two-space source indentation; no syntax was minified or identifiers shortened.

tests.name: layout and runtime
tests.evidence: Both viewports retained exact stage and scroll dimensions, one visible Canvas, zero page/console errors and zero failed requests.

tests.name: original selfcheck
tests.evidence: No clipping, escape, overlap, undersized text, failed resource or runtime error.

tests.name: motion and input lifecycle
tests.evidence: Normal frames evolve; Space freezes and resumes the Canvas; R rebuilds from the fixed seed; pagehide freezes work and removes keyboard handling.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: The 5200 ms representative frame remains stable without a live loop and Space reports the reduced-motion state.

cross_audit.issue_found: The first candidate cached theme colors only at startup, whereas baseline refreshes static colors on rebuild and the animated trajectory color on every render.
cross_audit.fix: Restored the baseline token-read cadence without reintroducing unused color roles or per-call palette object allocation.
